UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private learner profile for a student using CodeFix Lab.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when profile was last updated.

ChallengeProgress.title: ChallengeProgress
ChallengeProgress.description: Per-challenge code submission, completion state, and study notes for a learner.

challengeId.description: Slug identifier of the debugging challenge.

status.description: Current completion status for this challenge.

savedHtml.description: Latest HTML code saved by the student.

savedJs.description: Latest JavaScript code saved by the student.

studyNote.description: Personal study takeaway recorded by the student.

solvedAt.description: Server timestamp when all behavioral tests first passed.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when progress record was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when progress record was last updated.

/users/{userId}.description: Private student profile documents keyed by Auth UID.

/users/{userId}/progress/{challengeId}.description: Per-challenge code state, test status, and study notes owned by the user.
